opening.argument: The speaker tests the purported Adopt Me game-pass glitch and reports the result plainly: “nothing is free.” After demonstrating the proposed chat-code method, the speaker calls it fake and warns that anyone claiming it works is a liar and a scammer. The video also promotes separate in-game giveaways conditioned on subscribing, liking, and enabling notifications. That engagement request is distinct from the tested free-game-pass claim. The central message is that the method does not work, not an invitation to pursue a deceptive claim or verification flow.

citations.quote: As you guys can see, this was obviously fake.
anybody who tells you can do this is obviously a liar and a scammer
all you have to do is subscribe and turn on post notifications and like this video
